expected_outcomes_note: Per-scenario expected outcome of listed rows, read by scripts/dmt_regression_run.py. Key = DMT_RECORD_DETAIL_V.SUB_OBJECT; rows keyed by the STG SOURCE_ID. Outcomes: LOADED; FAILED (its own real Fusion error); FAILED_WITH_DOCUMENT (FAILED because Fusion rejected its whole document; ERROR_TEXT must contain 'Rejected with document:', design section 5). Rows not listed fall back to the BAD key-marker rule. A sub-object may give 'key_col' (an STG column) when its SOURCE_ID is a parent link rather than its own key (MiscReceipts lots/serials).
